Connecting communities. Building the future.

We're working to transform over 100 miles of historic railroad corridors into a connected network of trails that brings people and communities together. Places to explore, enjoy the outdoors, and experience the beauty of the Monadnock Region.

Explore our vision

There's work to be done. And we're making progress.

Mile by mile, bridge by bridge, we're making our regional trail network a reality. We've accomplished a lot, but there's much more to do. See how far we've come and what's next.

See our projects

Get involved. We need you!

These trails are for all of us. Whether you donate, volunteer, or help spread the word, you can be part of completing a trail network that will benefit our communities for generations to come.

Five trails, one connected network

Existing home map section, unchanged. Shown only to mark where the new section sits.

There's work to be done!

The Monadnock Region's rail trails have come a long way. Through the efforts of dedicated volunteers, community partners, municipalities, and generous supporters, sections of these historic corridors have been restored and improved for public enjoyment.

But the network is far from complete. There are bridges to restore, trail surfaces to improve, connections to establish, and miles of trail still waiting to reach their potential.

We're making progress, one project at a time.

Recently completed

Every completed project brings us closer to a more connected network of trails. From improved trail surfaces to restored crossings and better access, these accomplishments show what can happen when people and communities work together.
